title: Coincidence of invariant measure for the alternate base transformations
summary: We characterize all pairs $(β,n),(β^\prime,m)$ such that the alternate $(β,n)$ and $(β^\prime,m)$-transformations $K_{(β,n)}$ and $K_{(β^\prime,m)}$ have the same absolutely continuous invariant measure, where $K_{(β,n)}(i,x)=(i+1 \mod 2 ,T_i(x))$ with $i\in\{0,1\}$, $T_0(x)=T_β(x)=βx \mod 1$, $T_1(x)=T_n(x)=nx\mod 1$ with $β>1$ real and $n\geq 2$ an integer.
